R-PDD-SEC-001 Technical Mandate: Securing the Information Technology (IT) Infrastructure. 
The Technical Mandate outlines the various IT security requirements for both the RITS and RMDA teams. It also includes specific guidance on security incident response, security testing, and threat intelligence. The main goal is to ensure that all personnel have a thorough understanding of IT security principles and best practices.
